title: Uranium
body:
Description


Uranium can only spawn on Grimestone nodes. though there's some evidence on older version of the game that uranium can spawn on other certain nodes. Uranium can spawn with a chance of about 1/500.

However, there is a place in the Acidlands called Acid Smog. There, the main spawn is Uranium. But it does damage, so you need a fusion coil or healing coil to survive.

Raw Uranium is a shade of dark green. It can most easily be found within the (new) Acidlands within the Grimestone.

It is recommended you use a Metal Detector purchased in the Gizmo's Observatory as it makes it easier to distinguish between the ink that also spawns in the Acidlands.

Putting Uranium into a refiner raises the sell price to $250 per stud. Putting that refined Uranium through a forge further increases the price to $680 per stud and changes material to neon.
